name: Ryut
source:
"If we keep pushing forward, we're bound to succeed one day."

Leader of the new idol group Starfire, Ryut has a talent in songwriting. A perfectionist to his core, he is disciplined and meticulous. 
He is reserved but deeply devoted in love. Often mistaken as distant due to an inability to communicate effectively, he is actually a quiet supporter and protector of those around him.

Zodiac: Capricorn
Animal Aspect: Cat
Hobby: Songwriting

[From [url=https://www.godly-love.com/en/]website[/url]]
